planSteps.description: Click on 'Domicilio normal' option in step 0
Click on the origin barrio search input and type 'Centro'
Select the first 'Centro' option from the dropdown
Click on the destination barrio search input and type 'Centro'
Select the second 'Centro' option or another nearby barrio from the dropdown
Enter 'Calle 10 # 15-20' in the origin direction field
Enter 'Carrera 5 # 10-15' in the destination direction field
The price summary should show a 'Tarifa base' with a value of $5.000 (mismo sector Centro)
The price summary should NOT show a peso recargo line (10kg = Entre 1 a 15 kg = $0, should be excluded)
The price summary should NOT show a transferencia recargo line
The total should be exactly $5.000 (tarifa base only, no recargos)
